parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for the HDAC6 assay CHEMBL1865. Require compounds to have a canonical SMILES and activities to come from a PubMed-indexed document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (inner join on molregno) to enforce SMILES presence. Join compound_records and docs to acquire compound_key and publication provenance (pubmed_id, doi). Join activities and assays to link to the target. Filter assays by chembl_id CHEMBL1865 and activities by standard_type IC50. Filter docs where pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Return all requested columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; preserve all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
